selection_basis: Originals from the overall accepted and publication-authorized series; no claim every technical target passed.
preserve: directional natural courtyard or window light
layered silk and gauze material response
restrained embroidery and warm wood relationships
variable: age within the current young-adult-female demo requirement
wardrobe design and palette within the style family

Window-light material response, architecture-to-garden depth and purposeful action. Historical mature casting is not the future demo casting target.
